notes: Ordered rules; the first match wins. Purpose says why a route exists.
Status says why it is or is not imported, and is overridden to BOUND for any
route the ctypes manifest actually imports.
ACTIONABLE_LOCAL means: needed by a selected deliverable and implementable now.
A capability CNA offers that this product has not selected is a deliberate
non-binding, not an outstanding task; binding a route with no consumer is not
cnb.h is a selected family: its routes are ACTIONABLE_LOCAL until bound, which
is what makes an unbound one a task rather than a decision. The two exceptions
carry their own rule and their own reason.
engine_layer.h is a selected family. It has no blanket rule: every route is
claimed by a named family, so a route CNA adds that no family covers becomes
UNREVIEWED and fails the gate rather than being absorbed as deliberate.
2026-09-02: six scopes were selected by explicit product decision. The four
blanket rules that stood in for hundreds of routes -- sensors-devices,
extended-input, net-profile and gamer-services-profile -- are gone, replaced by
per-sub-family rules. Like engine_layer.h, these families have no blanket rule:
a route no sub-family claims is UNREVIEWED and fails the gate.

rules.reason: RenderTarget2D/Cube ContentLost is XNA public surface and CNA now has the subscription; delivery only happens on renderers that can lose a device.

rules.reason: These refuse instead of wrapping around when two file-declared 64-bit values are combined. Python integers are unbounded, so the same computation is already exact; calling them would convert an exact answer into a narrower one. The bound checks that do matter happen in _cna_native.cnb_support, where a value has to fit a native width.
rules.boundReason: not applicable: Python's own arithmetic is exact

rules.reason: The minimal curve.h slice the CNB curve codec needs: cna_cnb_encode_curve takes a native Curve handle and cna_cnb_decode_curve produces one, so the codec is unreachable from a managed-only Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Curve. A dependency of the selected CNB profile, not a decision to bind curve.h.
rules.boundReason: imported: the CNB curve codec builds a native curve from managed keys and reads one back, destroying it before either function returns

rules.reason: The minimal content.h slice the CNB loader registry needs: cna_cnb_loader_invoke takes a content manager and refuses without one, measured rather than assumed, so a registered loader could otherwise be resolved and never run. Exactly create and destroy; no load, cache or root-directory route is bound, and this manager shares nothing with Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Content.ContentManager.
rules.boundReason: imported: cna.extensions.content.NativeContentManager is the collaborator CNA's loader signature demands

rules.reason: The CLR type name is not XNA public surface; Python names its own types, and ToString is projected separately where XNA defines it.
rules.boundReason: not applicable: no CLR type-name route is imported

rules.reason: Disposal is tracked deterministically by the Python ownership model, which is authoritative earlier than CNA's flag and stays correct after the handle is released.
rules.boundReason: imported for the Media catalog graph, whose facades are invalidated by their provider root and by Game generation rather than only by their own Dispose, so CNA's flag is the authority for whether the native object is still usable

rules.familyTitle: C ownership transfer Python does not need
rules.reason: The C form of a unique_ptr parameter: it exists because C has no way to say "keep this alive", so it transfers ownership and invalidates the caller's handle. Python's reference already guarantees exactly that lifetime -- an EffectPass holds its effect, a PostProcessChain holds its passes and a Skybox holds its environment cube -- so binding these would cost capability rather than add it: CNA would invalidate a live Effect facade, which could then no longer set a parameter. The borrowing constructors give the same guarantee with nothing invalidated.
rules.boundReason: not applicable: no C ownership transfer is imported

rules.familyTitle: the minimal slice the ASCII pass and effect need
rules.reason: The minimal graphics_ext.h slice the selected ASCII family cannot work without. cna_ascii_pass_get_effect hands out the effect that carries the pass's cell size and quantize mode, and no engine_layer.h route can read or write either, so without these the pass would have a getter returning something nothing could use. Its create and draw are here too, because they are the only way to quantize an arbitrary texture into an arbitrary rectangle: an AsciiPass runs inside a post-process chain and can do neither. A dependency of the selected engine profile, not a decision to bind graphics_ext.h.
rules.boundReason: imported: the ASCII pass cannot be configured without it, and the standalone effect is the only way to draw one into a chosen rectangle

rules.familyTitle: the minimal slice the PBR family cannot work without
rules.reason: The minimal graphics_ext.h and effects.h slice the selected PBR family cannot work without. cna_pbr_material_ext_init is the only route that fills a 27-field material with CNA's own defaults, and engine_layer.h declares no route that creates a PbrEffect, so without the two constructors every PBR route in it is unreachable. The texture pair is there because cna_pbr_effect_apply_material drops all seven texture slots (ENGINE-005), so without it a PBR effect could never have a texture. A dependency of the selected engine profile, not a decision to bind either header.
rules.boundReason: imported: the PBR family is unreachable without it -- see docs/engine-upstream-findings.md ENGINE-005

selectedFamilies.label: CNB_CNJ

`cnb.h` plus the two dependency slices its codecs and loader registry need.
Every route here is BOUND or carries its own written non-binding reason.

selectedFamilies.label: ENGINE
selectedFamilies.title: CNA's modern engine layer
selectedFamilies.description:
`engine_layer.h`, grouped into named sub-families. There is no blanket rule:
a route no sub-family claims is UNREVIEWED and fails the gate. Every route here
is BOUND or carries its own written non-binding reason.

selectedFamilies.label: DEVICES
selectedFamilies.title: CNA's sensors and device services

`sensors.h` and `devices.h`, grouped into named sub-families. There is no
blanket rule: a route no sub-family claims is UNREVIEWED and fails the gate.

selectedFamilies.label: ONLINE

`net.h`, `net_gamers.h`, `net_sessions.h` and `gamer_services.h`, grouped into
named sub-families. These back a selected *strict* profile rather than a CNA-only

assemblies the `xna40-windows-online` profile pins.
